name: Keiko-san (47) my co-worker, is a single mother
source:
An adult visual novel game and its hentai game with full animation, tells the story of a widowed woman named "Tanaka-Keiko". she was abandoned by her husband, and her daughter chose to follow him. Due to living alone and experiencing economic problems, Keiko has to work at a mini market that almost went bankrupt because there were no customers. A teenage man also works at the mini market, the man named Fujimoto-Arata with a handsome face and a stocky body, this is where the co-workers met.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1834420/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一款包含完整动画的成人视觉小说，讲述一位名叫田中惠子的独身女性的故事。她被丈夫抛弃，女儿也选择跟随父亲离开。由于独自生活、经济拮据，惠子不得不在一家因无人光顾而濒临倒闭的便利店工作。店里还有一位名叫藤本新的十几岁青年，长相俊朗，身材结实。两人就这样成为了同事。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1834420/]Steam[/url]]
